output.headline: TPG has an open platform in the target's sub-sector, three deals there, and capacity to pay up to $356M against a $300M value.
output.differentiator: Most National-region deals on the priority list (4), plus three Health IT deals and an open platform in the sub-sector. It also has the capacity to pay up to $356M.
output.why_them: Add-on to an open platform; most National-region deals on the list

acquirer_overview.title: A large-cap sponsor with an 18-deal record, mostly outside Health IT
points: Financial sponsor with 18 deals from 2016 to 2023; 15 closed (83%). Home sub-sector is Health Insurance [B:buyer, T:record, K:closed_share].
$303.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025 (TPG Inc.) [P:1].
Deals range from $7M to $1,388M with a median of $88M; 15 of 18 sit outside Health IT [T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by same-sub-sector deals
points: Open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on; Platform Build is a motive in 5 of 18 deals [A:angles, M:platform_build].
Technology Capability drives 3 of 18 deals, a distinct motive; it has 3 deals in the target's own sub-sector [M:technology_capability, T:record].
Prior National-region buying is a modest factor for; having bought from this kind of seller is a slight factor against [S:geo_fit, S:own_fit_s].

precedent_activity.title: Health IT precedents at 19.6x to 23.5x, plus one very large deal
points: Paramount Care Management Tech: $22M bolt-on, 2021, 23.5x, closed. Eastern Digital Health: $28M platform investment, 2021, 19.6x, withdrawn [D:MA-2021-0113, D:MA-2021-0380].
Cardinal Bio: $1,388M management buyout, 2022, 29.7x, closed, showing it can write much larger cheques [D:MA-2022-0172].

valuation_context.title: Median anchor of 21.4x is justified, and TPG can pay it
points: 13 same-sub-sector comparables show 19.4x to 23.3x with a 21.4x median; the 25.0% margin beats the 22.2% comps median, so the 50th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
TPG's own median paid is 15.7x, below the comparable median, though it paid 23.3x and 23.5x in its closed Health IT deals [V:comps, D:MA-2018-0003, D:MA-2021-0113].
At 5.0x leverage and an $239M equity cheque, IRR at the ask is 25.3% against a 20% target; maximum price is $356M [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV; only 6 of 18 deals sit in the comparable size band [T:record, K:size_band].
risk_flags.mitigant: Cardinal Bio at $1,388M shows it can underwrite far larger transactions [D:MA-2022-0172].
risk_flags.reality: Size is not a capacity constraint, but the target is above its usual range [T:record, V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Price discipline
risk_flags.concern: Its 15.7x median paid sits well below the 21.4x comparable median, so it may bid low [V:comps].
risk_flags.mitigant: It paid 23.3x and 23.5x for Health IT assets, and the IRR at the ask of 25.3% leaves room [D:MA-2018-0003, D:MA-2021-0113, V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: A bid near the median looks affordable, with a $356M ceiling [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Crowded process, thin Health IT focus
risk_flags.concern: 15 of 18 deals are outside Health IT, and it ranks 6th on the priority list at 3.7% likelihood [T:record, R:rank].
risk_flags.mitigant: Other sponsors, such as Blackstone, also show three deals in the sub-sector; TPG's open platform gives it an add-on route [A:angles].
risk_flags.reality: One Health IT deal was withdrawn; execution record is 15 of 18 closed [D:MA-2021-0380, K:closed_share].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector and an open platform support the add-on route, but a median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV [C:conviction, T:record, A:angles].
